meta.name: durable-objects
meta.description: Build, debug, or review Cloudflare Durable Objects code for persistent state and coordination.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建、调试并审查云端应用的状态与协同逻辑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正在云上开发需要保存进度并协调各步骤的应用。
copy.tagline_en: Build, debug, and review cloud app state and coordination logic
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing cloud apps that need to save progress and coordinate steps.

howto.what: Claude 会先查阅官方文档,再按技能规则编写、调试或审查 Durable Objects 代码(类、RPC、闹钟、WebSocket、wrangler 配置、测试等),并指出不符合官方最佳实践的地方。
howto.when: 当用户提出要编写、调试或审查 Cloudflare Durable Objects 代码,例如新建 DO 类、实现 RPC/闹钟、配置 wrangler 等时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 Durable Object 类,用 SQL 保存聊天室消息。
say.note: Claude 会先查官方文档,再给出带建表逻辑的类代码。

say.text: 审查这段 Durable Objects 代码,指出哪里不符合官方最佳实践。
say.note: Claude 会列出问题并给出修改建议。

say.text: 帮我配置 wrangler.jsonc 的 DO 绑定和 SQLite 迁移。
say.note: Claude 会给出配置片段和迁移步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude first looks up the official Cloudflare docs, then writes, debugs, or reviews Durable Objects code (classes, RPC, alarms, WebSocket, wrangler config, tests) based on the skill rules, pointing out anything that violates best practices.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to write, debug, or review Cloudflare Durable Objects code for persistent state and coordination, such as creating new DO classes, adding RPC/alarm handlers, or configuring wrangler.

say_en.text: Create a Durable Object class that stores chat-room messages in SQL.
say_en.note: Claude will consult the docs first, then return the class with table setup.

say_en.text: Review this Durable Objects code against the official best practices.
say_en.note: Claude will list issues and suggest fixes.

say_en.text: Configure wrangler.jsonc with DO bindings and SQLite migrations.
say_en.note: Claude will give a config snippet and migration steps.
